description: ORC-001 PoC attacker header H1. Child of real Bitcoin block 42328. Its hash beats block 42328's REAL target (nBits 0x1c654657, difficulty 2.53), i.e. it carries one genuine block of proof-of-work at Feb-2010 difficulty, but it DECLARES nBits 0x2100ffff (target ~2^256*(1-2^-16), integer difficulty 0), which makes every later header free. Mined once with mine-h1.c.
